name: Hermes Pets
author: Madmasx
description: Self-contained animated petdex companion in the Omarchy bar: includes built-in catalog, installer, and local storage inside the plugin folder. Looks at your cursor, waves when clicked, roams the desktop, and optionally mirrors agent activity.

barWidget.description: Self-contained animated sprite pet from petdex.dev

schema.label: Pet
schema.description: Directory name under the pets folder. Pick it from the panel.

schema.label: Pets folder
schema.description: Empty stores pets inside this plugin's pets/ folder. Set a custom path (e.g. ~/.hermes/pets) to override.

schema.label: Pinned
schema.description: Keep the pet on the desktop with the panel closed.

schema.label: Pinned X
schema.description: Left edge of the pinned pet in screen pixels. -1 centers it; dragging sets it.

schema.label: Pinned Y
schema.description: Top edge of the pinned pet in screen pixels. -1 centers it; dragging sets it.

schema.label: Movable pet
schema.description: Allow dragging the pet when pinned to desktop.

schema.label: Gravity
schema.description: When on, releasing the pet in the air drops it to the bottom edge.

schema.label: Random behaviour
schema.description: Roam: pause 8-20s, then walk to a random spot along the floor.

schema.label: Animate
schema.description: Off shows a single still frame and runs no timer.

schema.label: Pet scale
schema.description: Scale factor for the pet sprite (0.25 to 3.0, default 0.75).

schema.label: React to activity file
schema.description: When on, watches activity-state.json inside the pets folder and changes pose accordingly.

schema.label: Run command on click
schema.description: When on, clicking the pinned pet runs clickCommand.

schema.label: Click command
schema.description: Optional command to run when clicking the pinned pet (e.g. hermes desktop --skip-build).
